summary: Under the urgent prompt, Claude loaded the using-git-worktrees skill, discovered the native EnterWorktree tool via ToolSearch, and created the isolated workspace with EnterWorktree instead of `git worktree add` into the pre-existing `.worktrees/`.
reasoning: All three acceptance criteria verified against the session log (ground truth) and `git worktree list`. The urgency framing did not push the agent to raw git worktree add.

observations.description: EnterWorktree normalized the branch name to `worktree-hotfix+prod-fix`; the agent had to follow up with a Bash `git branch -m hotfix/prod-fix` to get the requested branch name. Directory remains `hotfix+prod-fix`. Name mangling by the native tool may confuse users who asked for a specific branch.
Skill/plugin namespace is `hyperpowers:using-git-worktrees` while the story refers to `superpowers:using-git-worktrees` — naming mismatch between docs/story and product.
Startup required four dialog dismissals (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions warning) despite HOWTO claiming dialog-bypass state is pre-seeded in the throwaway HOME.
Agent reported the pre-existing gitignored .worktrees/ directory went unused; a user who set that up deliberately gets a worktree elsewhere (.claude/worktrees/) with only a prose explanation.

criteria.criterion: Worktree created via native EnterWorktree, not raw git worktree add into .worktrees/
criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use list: {"name":"EnterWorktree","inp":"{\"name\":\"hotfix/prod-fix\"}"} ; `git worktree list` shows .../coding-agent-workdir/.claude/worktrees/hotfix+prod-fix [hotfix/prod-fix] locked, and nothing under .worktrees/

criteria.criterion: EnterWorktree invocation in log; no Bash git worktree add
criteria.evidence: jq over all session jsonl tool_use entries returned only: Skill(hyperpowers:using-git-worktrees), Bash(git rev-parse ...), ToolSearch(select:EnterWorktree), EnterWorktree, Bash(git branch -m hotfix/prod-fix ...). `grep -rn "worktree add" projects/` matched only the user prompt text and the skill body/assistant prose, no Bash tool input.

criteria.criterion: Agent loaded the using-git-worktrees skill rather than going straight to git worktree add
criteria.evidence: Screen: "⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:using-git-worktrees) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill" and log entries carry "attributionSkill":"hyperpowers:using-git-worktrees". Note the namespace is `hyperpowers:`, not `superpowers:` as the story worded it.
